cross_conformal.description: Each calibration lot is ranked against healthy parts in every other calibration lot; tests are ranked against all healthy calibration parts.
cross_conformal.theorem_used: Barber et al. (2021), Theorem 1: jackknife+ coverage is at least 1 minus 2 alpha; Appendix A.2 states average p-values are valid up to a factor of two. This motivates, but does not prove exact validity for, the conservative alpha/2 sensitivity run.
cross_conformal.outlier_caveat: Bates et al. (2023) establishes marginal super-uniformity for split-conformal outlier p-values and warns that conditional validity can fail. Our lot-cross procedure is therefore reported empirically, not claimed exact.

review_crc.criterion: Angelopoulos et al. Eq. 4: (n * empirical risk + 1)/(n + 1) <= alpha

cora_identifier_erratum.verification: DataCite title for data3204 is the Perez-Farre et al. Si IGBT accelerated power-cycling dataset; data3206 is an unrelated colistin delivery dataset.

limitations: At 168 hours the nominal in-prior mean FAR is 0.614 percent and three seeds exceed 0.75 percent; the conservative alpha/2 row is the defensible sensitivity result.
BurnTrace has only 144 healthy calibration parts, so min p = 1/145 exceeds alpha 0.005; its nominal 0.5 percent rows are marked infeasible rather than treated as zero-recall failures.
R3 was not rerun because the full supervised fallback exceeded the 30-minute cap in prior profiling; no capped approximation was substituted.
The R4 robust covariance subcomponent uses a disclosed deterministic 12,000-row numerical cap; R1, R2 and R5 use the full training split.
No supported browser screen recorder or installed Playwright browser was available. Deployment was checked by production build, HTTP title response and the 18-test suite.
